scripts.dev: if [ -d vercel-api ]; then cd vercel-api && npm run dev; else npm run dev; fi
scripts.build: if [ -d vercel-api ]; then cd vercel-api && npm install && npm run build; else npm run build; fi
scripts.vercel-build: if [ -d vercel-api ]; then cd vercel-api && npm install && npm run vercel-build; else npm run vercel-build; fi
